x: In the Mens' 10Km race Carl Lawton saw Roger Mills of the home club off by 10 seconds but had, in turn, to give way to Seddon who thus gained revenge for the previous week's activities. Carl's time was 46:56 with Dobson (Southend) 44:35 and Seddon (BoE) 45:09.
Carl filled his normal forward role by placing 2nd in 46:34 to Ilford's Dobson 45:56. John Hall was 8th in 48:35, keeping that young upstart Dorman at bay by one position and nine seconds.
